accepted.text: Controller force magnitude never exceeds the scenario force limit because it is clipped.
Controller force magnitude is non-negative by definition.
Force limit is a scenario constant so it never changes during a run.
Scenario limits restrict force_limit to at most 80.
Scenario limits restrict force_limit to at least 40.
Stabilizing controller with small disturbances never lets the pole fall past horizontal.
Stabilizing controller with small disturbances never lets the pole fall past horizontal in the negative direction.
With balancing control and small pushes cart velocity stays within generous physical limits.
With balancing control and small pushes cart velocity stays within generous physical limits in the negative direction.
Balanced pole angular rate stays well below spin rates.
Balanced pole angular rate stays well above negative spin rates.
Total mechanical energy stays bounded because control forces and pushes do limited work on a balanced system.
